title: Replay product policy from recorded facts and signals
narrative: Taloneth needs deterministic policy replay from recorded facts and signals without re-running tools — so offline audits match live verdicts.
implementation:
`replay_verdict` in `mechaharness.decision_log` re-runs `decide()` on recorded facts/signals/policy for deterministic audits.

Covers: OBS-03.
validation: Kind `policy_replay` → `_run_policy_replay`. Soft expects: identical verdict kind on replay. Unit: decision_log / judgement_policy tests.
